name: Reevo
description: Bring your Reevo CRM into Claude. Pull up accounts, contacts, and opportunities, search your pipeline by stage, owner, or any field, and keep records current without leaving the conversation. Capture notes from calls and log tasks with due dates. Enroll prospects into outreach sequences, review email threads, and trace a full engagement timeline across every touchpoint. Reevo becomes a native part of your AI workflow so you can move deals forward, stay on top of follow-ups, and work your pipeline without switching tabs.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Reevo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Reevo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.reevo.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Reevo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Reevo lists 30 MCP tools, including create_accounts, create_contacts, create_custom_object_records, create_notes, create_opportunities, create_tasks, enroll_in_sequence, get_accounts, get_object_schema, list_mailboxes, list_pipelines, and search_accounts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Reevo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Reevo in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Reevo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Reevo is developed by Reevo Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
